testFeedback.status: candidate; shared TEST source loading and accuracy require closure

formula.SCminus: SC-negative shunt-side Kelvin voltage relative to GND_SYS; measurement or current/shunt compensation and its error remain unresolved

testControl.diagnostic: short HIGH pulse; check GPIO IDR and analog TEST_FB on PB15; wait ADC/RC settling; inspect tap response; restore LOW and verify digital and analog readback

diagnosticLimits: PB14 is one ADC observation serving both T8 and SC_SUM; no independent T8 cross-check exists.
Summing adjacent cell differences telescopes to the endpoints and cannot self-validate the PB14 channel.
PB15 analog TEST_FB improves shared TEST voltage observation but does not prove every tap channel open/short or resistor-drift coverage.
TLV6700 remains an independent hardware SC-total overvoltage path but does not establish complete tap-fault coverage.
All tap readings are relative to GND_SYS; do not assume SC_NEG_SHUNT_KELVIN equals GND_SYS.

currentLimitCandidate.architecture: DRV8161 SO feeds ADC and two non-inverting comparator inputs; internal DAC3 thresholds; comparator outputs route to TIM1 Break

comp2.intendedTrip: SO < lower threshold; output polarity must be configured accordingly
comp2.pinCapability: ADC2_IN4 capability exists but is not used as a tap

currentLimitCandidate.timer: TIM1 Break candidate; exact source combine, polarity, latch/rearm, MOE safe states and startup order require RM0440/register review and bench validation

calculationAssumptions.formula: VSO ~= 1.65 V + 0.010 V/A * I_SC, discharge positive

currentLimitCandidate.claimBoundary: ±80 A trip is an unapproved target candidate; ±140 A endpoints reach nominal CSA swing bounds and have no demonstrated margin; no hardware timing proof yet
notes: PA3 remains allocated to T4; PA7 is the second DRV_SO comparator input.
PB14 is not a comparator input; PB14 is reserved for shared SC_SUM/T8 ADC reading.
